ActorTalk: ...But as a little seed. Are you good with that, Commandant?
If you're the one taking care of me, then I'm sure.
Of course I'll be the one taking care of you! I'm the one who reviews your health reports, after all.
Even if you became a tiny seed, I'd still know all your little quirks. I'd even know which direction you're planning to grow.
Now then, close your eyes...
Temperature: 23.5°C. Humidity: 85%. Light-dark cycle: 16 hours of light, 8 hours of dark...
Liv, you look taller.
You're awake, Commandant? You're a little seed now.
I can't hear your voice clearly, Liv.
Mhm... You've just been planted in space soil. It's normal to feel a bit stifled.
But don't worry. I'm right here with you.
Is it normal for seeds to talk to their researchers?
Of course. I can hear the voices of other seeds too—we just talk through data instead.
How are you feeling now, Commandant? Cold? Thirsty?
I feel a little warm.
I'm a little thirsty.
Let's bring the temperature down a bit... How about now?
And raise the humidity a little more... Better?
Much better... but it's still dark.
Can you hear me now, Commandant?
Yeah... I just felt a little shock.
Phew... you scared me. A lot of seeds don't make it because they can't find the right direction to grow. I was trying to guide you using electric signals...
Can you see the glowing area around you now?
Yeah, I see a spot of light.
That's your guiding light. Want to try growing toward it?
(Grow toward the light source)
Don't be scared... Take it slow. I'm right here with you.
This world isn't perfect... and you'll face challenges you can't even imagine. But don't be afraid. I'll walk this road with you...
Just stay right here. Keep growing, little by little.
Yes, Liv?
So, Commandant, how did it feel being a little seed?
Felt a little rushed?
I wasn't ready for it to end.
Mhm... it's still a beta feature, after all.
If you'd like to experience sprouting all over again, I can bring you back here anytime. Who knows, maybe next time, these dandelions will have started to bloom.
Alright. I'll be your seed again next time, Liv.
I think once was enough...
Whether you're a seed or the Commandant...
To me, you're still you—my precious little seedling.
I'm getting sleepy all of a sudden...
It's probably a side effect of the simulation. After all, you were just "born."
Don't worry, I'm right here with you, Commandant.
Go on and rest... and when you reach the other side of the dream, don't forget to grow strong and bloom beautifully.
